indicator_name: Local budget execution by region, year to date: revenues (PIT, social tax, transfers), spending by function, subventions and withdrawals
description: Исполнение местных бюджетов по регионам с начала года: доходы (ИПН, соцналог, трансферты), расходы по функциям, субвенции и изъятия
unit: million KZT, January to the month
methodology: Minfin Statistical Bulletin tables 12 (all local budgets = national), 12.1-12.20 (one per region, matched by the sheet title) and 18 (17 before 2021-09; general transfers), every edition since 2013-01 (2013-2018 from the yearly archives, via scripts/backfill_minfin_bulletins.py --dims). Dated the first day of the period's last month; year to date (difference within a year for the month). Items: REV, REV.TAX, REV.CIT, REV.PIT, REV.SOCIAL_TAX, REV.EXCISE, REV.NONTAX, REV.CAPITAL, REV.TRANSFERS, EXP, EXP.01-EXP.15 (functional groups; 04 education, 05 health, 06 social assistance, 07 housing), NET_LENDING, FIN_ASSETS, BALANCE, SUBVENTIONS, WITHDRAWALS. Regions: 16 to mid-2018 (South Kazakhstan), then 17 (Turkestan and Shymkent), 20 from the August 2024 edition (Abai, Zhetisu, Ulytau; the 2022-09…2024-07 editions omit them though the parent regions already exclude them -- source_issues). Checked: the regions add up to table 12 within 0.5% in every edition with all region tables, except the source errors of 2020-02 (Shymkent) and 2021-02/03 (table 12) in source_issues. Targeted transfers received = REV.TRANSFERS - SUBVENTIONS. REV.PIT and REV.SOCIAL_TAX by region = a monthly regional wage-bill proxy. National rows start in 2014-12 (earlier table 12 has no period column); the regions are there from 2013-01. Missing editions: 2020-04, 2025-12, 2026-04.
